question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Of the old school

options.text: School in an old age home

solution:
The correct answer is **Old fashioned in thought**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• 
 The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom 'Of the old school' is 'Old fashioned in thought.'
 
 
• 
 **Of the old school:** Having views to values or traditions from an earlier era. (पहले के युग के मूल्यों या परंपराओं के बारे में विचार रखना।)

 
 
• 
 For example, *Ross is of the old school, he still believes in women working at home only.*
 
 
 
 
• 
 ​Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, option 3 is correct.
